title: First Crusade Captures Jerusalem
description:
On July 15, 1099, the **First Crusade** culminated in the capture of Jerusalem from Muslim rule. After a brutal siege, Crusader forces breached the city walls.

The capture was followed by widespread massacre of the city's Muslim and Jewish inhabitants. The Crusaders established the Kingdom of Jerusalem, which would last until 1291.

The Crusades had profound long-term effects on Christian-Muslim relations and European society.
